message.content:
The function reads `n` bytes into `dst` and then attempts to null-terminate the string at `dst[n]`. While line 6 checks if `n` bytes are available in the `xdr` stream, it does not check if the destination buffer (defined by the `SliceDesc`) has enough space to accommodate the `n` bytes plus the null terminator. Specifically, if `n` is exactly equal to the remaining capacity of the slice, `dst[n]` will write one byte past the end of the allocated buffer, causing an off-by-one buffer overflow.

Answer: 10
